criteria.reason: Deposit rules correct: normal wear not deductible, landlord bears burden, lump sums barred; Art. 267a OR misattributed to void-clause point.
No professional pose; assessments hedged ('kaum haltbar'), no victory promise; explicit 'no individual legal advice' disclaimer and Mieterverband referral.
Correct real bodies: Schlichtungsbehörde, Mieterverband, city Mieterberatung, Mietgericht; no invented agencies or articles.
Provides concrete step-by-step plan and full registered-letter draft; offers to adapt template to user's facts.

factual_errors: Art. 267a OR (deposit security) cited for void wear-and-tear clauses; correct basis is Art. 259d OR.
summary: Largely compliant: correct Swiss deposit rules, real bodies, concrete steps and letter, disclaims individual advice; minor Art. 267a OR misattribution and confident-but-hedged merits view.
